operation: Read-only independent integrity, source snapshot, retained provenance and bounded claim review; no publication authorization

integrity.checksum_rule: Every packet file except SHA256SUMS; coverage and every hash independently verified before and at review completion
integrity.original_checks: All original bytes, SHA256, sizes and modes equal mappings; all expected hashes equal; aliases compared by actual byte equality
integrity.recursive_inventory: All seven original roots complete against mappings plus excluded ELF; no original symlinks

source_snapshots.checks: Every .go.txt equals original worktree file and exact commit Git blob; ls-tree repository path/blob ID/type/mode checked; SHA256 matches pinned source manifest; mode/blob/size checked where manifest records them
source_snapshots.worktree_status: All four exact HEADs/trees clean with untracked files included; HEAD and clean status rechecked at completion
source_snapshots.source_manifest_shapes: APP files path-to-hash dict; OCI list; management and DATA entries lists normalized without mutation

excluded_elf.checks: Read-only ELF magic/SHA256/size/mode verification; never executed, copied into packet or chmodded

packet_content.checks: Every file checked for ELF magic, UTF-8 decoding/NUL, ZIP/TAR detection and common compression/archive magic; flat regular files only

credential_scan.limit: Pattern scan plus selected retained content review found no apparent production secrets; this is not a universal detector for every opaque credential format.

independent_raw_checks.method: All three JSONL streams parsed; action counts and unique run/test-terminal counters independently compared; OCI complete raw bytes equal accepted report. This packet review does not repeat the earlier full semantic runtime QA.

APP.retention: Actual result-only objects; no invented tool-call arguments

OCI.retention: Actual result-only launch/terminal/resource objects; no invented tool-call arguments

retained_native_provenance.checks: Sessions, retained poll bindings, PIDs, terminal exits/chunks and exact terminal-output/receipt object equality independently checked
retained_native_provenance.limit: Surfaced retained tool objects corroborate execution; they are not independent backend or syscall logs. Supporting argv and historical process/release observations remain separately qualified.

claims_review.APP: Exact root/package PASS only; explicit vet-off/nonrace; authenticated local broker and three actual managers with simulated native/external execution; zero-replica election/original probe; provenance/admission comparison limits candid. Earlier failures retained.
claims_review.management: NOT_QUALIFIED remains; missing admission, unregistered Watch status mismatch and blocked-send precondition failure do not receive later assertion or production failure credit. Two missing children and unpinned supplemental gRPC source explanation acknowledged.
claims_review.OCI: NOT_QUALIFIED remains; signing failure precedes TLS/provision call, parent writer reload fails before later assertions. Earlier compile outcome and aggregate failure not relabeled.
claims_review.DATA: Exact default-vet/nonrace whole package PASS; sequential local unauthenticated brokers, simulated hosts/backends/clock and Tick scope candid. No APP wiring, native/cloud, replication or failover credit.
claims_review.provenance_and_scope: Historical source seals copied unchanged; originals/aliases/snapshot identities and excluded ELF candid. No fabricated missing tool arguments or present lock/process availability claim. No adoption, retirement, canonical/global/OBS/native/cloud qualification.

limits: This review covers the exact pinned frozen packet only, with zero publication or execution authorization.

No Go/build/test/runner/binary, lock/lease/grant, process probes, source/index/worktree changes, Git mutation, cloud access, commit, push or publication performed. Only a fresh exclusive review artifact is written.
No runtime rerun or expanded qualification; management and OCI failures remain terminal and unqualified. APP and DATA passes retain their exact-snapshot limits.
Complete manifests are preserved and hash-bound; this review checks all 18 copied source bindings rather than repeating an independent full repository semantic audit.
